anna_ops: FYI vendor shipped 12 H100s to FRA (AWB ZX9-3344). crate 2 has a crush mark but vendor claims bench pass. depot wants formal inspection before releasing.
liam_procure: Pls paste invoice link. last week we had EUR vs USD mismatch that held a shipment at customs.
acme_ops: Link to invoice: https://acme.example/invoice/ZX9-3344. We accidentally used EUR billing template 50. we'll reissue corrected invoice and a credit memo by EOD. apologies.
diego_infra: Capacity note 50 EU edge pool at 88% now. If those 6 designated for edge are delayed we risk throttling batch jobs scheduled at 15:00 CET. Any temporary repool options?
sophie_logistics: Depot review window is tomorrow 08:30-16:30 CET. Photos uploaded to portal. Depot says superficial panel scuff, no visible fin damage. They require signed QA acceptance to refuse RMA.
acme_ops: We will accept depot-level functional assessment. If depot flags DOA/perf regression we will cover return freight and overnight replacement. Corrected invoice + credit memo will be posted before 3998881238.
sre_bot: @channel Alert: EU-edge available GPUs projected < 10 in 5h; p95 latency SLO at risk. Recommend repool or borrow from dedicated pools.
anna_ops: Liam, can we borrow up to 4 from Dedicated for a 12h window? We'll track usage and return at 03:00 UTC.
liam_procure: I can approve a 4-unit temp repool but need confirmation that vendor will issue corrected invoice before customs cut-off, otherwise customs hold + duties. I will also withhold final payment until docs fixed.
diego_infra: Technical: repool will require graceful cordon + migrate workloads. Expect ~90s socket reconnects per node. We'll do rolling handoff at 3998881239.
sophie_logistics: Vendor: confirm you'll waive return shipping if depot declares units functional. If not, confirm replacement SLA (48h for EU).
acme_ops: Confirmed: waive return shipping if depot passes. Replacement SLA 48h for EU. Corrected docs ETA 3998881237.
anna_ops: Checklist: 1) vendor corrected invoice & credit memo by 3998881237 2) temp repool 4 units scheduled at 3998881239 3) depot QC tomorrow 08:30-16:30 CET 4) if depot fails, vendor covers RMA shipping & replacement within 48h.
liam_procure: Agreed. I'll tag finance to hold payment until credit memo posted.
sre_bot: Noted: scheduling repool will reduce dedicated pool capacity; set temporary alert for affected tenants.
anna_ops: Thanks all. I'll update the ticket and ops runbook.
